newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF, BOJ keeping close contact on forex - Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: MOF, BOJ keeping close contact on forex - Sakakibara.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) and the Ministry of Finance (MOF) are keeping in close contact on currencies and will maintain such contacts in the future, senior MOF official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Tuesday.
Sakakibara, head of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, said the government has the sole responsibility for decisions on intervention in currency markets.
"However, the BOJ and MOF are keeping very close cooperative ties on currencies. We will continue to maintain such a relationship," he told a parliamentary committee.
